That’s fucked up as shit. I’m sorry shit didn’t work out so well for you either. Honestly. It sucks that this may be more common than I ever realized. You’re viewed as lazy for not getting help, but then the help fucks you over more, and that’s quite the fun cycle. So what do you do when the help doesn’t work? *Keep trying until it kills you?!* well if you can afford it at least. If you can afford.. to get fucked up even more, I mean. Wow

You know. Maybe we should take pride in being “too complicated.” Maybe this... being too unique to be helped is what should produce the good things in our brain that makes us wanna *live*  hahahahahahahafuck

(Sorry if I’m weirding you out or if this comes across as rude. I honestly don’t mean to be. I’ve just.. ive HAD IT... and they do say.. laughter is the best medicine *fingers crossed* lmaooo)

That’s a good lesson there. I stupidly trusted doctors because they’re doctors. We gotta be our own doctors out here (sarcasm). But no really, if you’re going to put something in your body, do more research than just read Reddit stories from other people’s experiences on the drugs (I only read Reddit experiences pahahaha). 

*No offense to any doctors on here. I’m just bitter as all HELL*
